name: call-calendar
description: Календарь звонков — сервис для бронирования календаря

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/server && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.spec:generate: npm run spec && npm run spec:client && npm run spec:server
scripts.spec:check: npm run spec && git diff --exit-code -- spec/output
scripts.spec:client:check: npm run spec:client && git diff --exit-code -- apps/web/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.spec:server:check: npm run spec:server && git diff --exit-code -- apps/server/src/api/schema.d.ts
